findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "deadbolt_check_supabase_access" stacks urgency/override words (never, bypass). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: slopscore_check_website, tells_check_writing, doorman_check_ai_bot_access, mend_repair_json, mend_query_json, deadbolt_check_supabase_access, stamp_check_email_domain · Private data: tokendiet_count_tokens, runsheet_create_schedule, swatch_make_scale, meridian_convert_time, mend_repair_json, mend_outline_json, mend_query_json, deadbolt_check_supabase_access, deadbolt_catalog_query, spill_scan_secrets, stamp_check_email_domain, stamp_check_dns_record · Public sink: tokendiet_count_tokens, tells_check_writing, runsheet_create_schedule, halves_settle_up, halves_create_group_link, meridian_convert_time, mend_query_json, spill_scan_secrets, stamp_check_email_domain, stamp_check_dns_record, tick_next_runs · Destructive: aitab_total_ai_subscriptions, runsheet_create_schedule, deadbolt_check_supabase_access, deadbolt_catalog_query, spill_scan_secrets.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
